about.title: About me
about.text: Frontend Developer with experience in React, Next.js, and modern CSS frameworks such as Tailwind CSS. My background in design allows me to effectively integrate visual and technical solutions, providing a comprehensive approach to development.

list.title: Landing Pages & Promo Websites

davai.title: Davai s nami
davai.content: A frontend website built with Next.js that allows users to search for events in Saint Petersburg by category, date, and popular locations. Events are aggregated on the backend and displayed on the website. The project is also available as a Telegram Web App.

baton.title: Baton — Figma to React
baton.content: A Figma plugin that converts selected designs into React and Tailwind CSS code. Baton parses Figma layers, normalizes their structure, resolves layout relationships, and generates reusable React components. The project uses a custom design-to-code pipeline with a strongly typed intermediate representation and an extensive Vitest test suite.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.content: The project is a frontend website built using Next.js. It allows users to search for events in Saint Petersburg by category, date, and popular locations. All events are aggregated on the backend and displayed on the site. The website functions as a web application and is also accessible via a Telegram bot.
